<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 11"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Hunter's Anthem](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2867)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 242

**Price** 1,300 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** 2
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Weapon** [Longbow](/Weapons.aspx?ID=436)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This +_2 striking [longbow](/Weapons.aspx?ID=76)_ is carefully handcrafted from a length of flexible green-tinted wood, etched in a variety of runic symbols, and strung with a dawnsilver bowstring. When you shoot the bow in rapid succession, the echoing chords generated by the bowstring form a haunting dirge that evokes the inevitable end of all things. If you have the Hunt Prey class feature, the weapon gains the thundering rune on Strikes against your prey. 

**Activate—Song of the Bow** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You shoot an arrow thrumming with the song of the bow. Make a Strike with the bow that deals damage as normal. As long as the Strike isn't a critical failure, the arrow explodes in a 20-foot emanation around your target, dealing 5d10 sonic damage to creatures in the area, including the target, with a DC 28 basic Fortitude save. Any creature that critically fails is [deafened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=8) for 1 minute. If any creature in the area is [undetected](/Conditions.aspx?ID=39) or [unnoticed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=41) by you, you learn its location, making it [hidden](/Conditions.aspx?ID=22) to you instead. 

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
name: Hunter's Anthem
